decisions.reason: The psychiatric day-patient program is close to the firm's mental health core, already has its own page indicating early commitment, and can be kept open at low cost while demand uncertainty resolves.

The carpentry workshop is a related but less central production option with a dedicated page, but its custom-furniture demand is still uncertain and workshop costs are moderate, so it remains worth keeping.
Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to established care and likely cheap to run as a pilot, so the firm holds the option while it learns about demand.
The senior-living counseling service appears on the home page and fits the eldercare strategy closely, making its option value high and drop risk very low.

The sheltered-workshop retail shop is mission-aligned but more peripheral and only mentioned on the website, so its higher operating uncertainty gives it a higher but still not dominant drop probability.
